lead.headline: Lost by 14.5 with 61.7 left on the bench; this week's zeros are already in the lineup
lead.deck: Barkley projects 0.0, Rice and Waller are on bye. Two swaps add 27.5 points today, and a tight end comes free after 01:00 Wednesday.
lead.body: Week 4 ended 63.7 to 78.2 after Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday night. Saquon Barkley and Rashee Rice left with hamstring injuries after 2.0 points between them, and those exits can't be graded as calls. Alvin Kamara's 22.8, Carnell Tate's 21.5 and Ollie Gordon's 18.0 stayed on your bench; the best lineup would have scored 61.7 more, in a game lost by 14.5. The bad news for Week 5 is sitting in your lineup. Barkley is 'week-to-week', one report says he is unlikely for London, and ESPN projects him at 0.0. Rice is on bye. So is Darren Waller, your only tight end. As set you project 78.2 against Kings of the North's 123.4. Two swaps fix most of it and need no ruling. Bhayshul Tuten, who took 74% of Jacksonville's carries, goes into Barkley's slot at 14.0. Tate goes into Rice's at 13.5, with Matthew Golden in the flex over Josh Downs by 0.7, a coin flip that goes to the projection. The tight end needs patience. Four project within 0.8 of each other and all are on waivers until 01:00 on Wednesday. A claim would cost a place in an order that never resets, for a coin flip's edge. Wait, then add the best one left: Mark Andrews unless Lamar Jackson has been ruled out, then Brenton Strange, then Colston Loveland. The seat is Waller's, and taking it bends two of this brief's own rules; the card says which and why. The same Wednesday-morning visit is the time to swap the Ravens' defence for the Jaguars', who face an Eagles offence missing most of its backfield.

cannotSee.label: Which tight ends will clear
cannotSee.body: Andrews, Hockenson, Strange and Loveland are all on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City. ESPN shows only your own claims, so I can't see who is ahead of you; you are 8th of ten. The card's order is the plan; who is left is Wednesday's fact.

cannotSee.label: Medical results
cannotSee.body: No scan result is public for Barkley, Rice or Lamar Jackson. Barkley's ruling is promised for Wednesday, after waivers process. Jackson's decides whether Andrews's 10.4 means anything.

cannotSee.label: The two rules the third card bends
cannotSee.body: Dropping Waller breaks the letter of the churn rule (his seat changed on 3 Oct) and of the open-thesis rule (neither clause has tripped). I read a bye at a one-man position as the same thing as a ruling-out for this week. That is my interpretation, not the runbook's words.

cannotSee.label: Whether the projection has Monday night
cannotSee.body: Kamara's 10.0 was published after his game. I can't see when ESPN last recomputed it, so 'priced' for Monday's news is an inference from the timestamp.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Every tile comes from FootballDB's points allowed through Week 4, standard scoring and four games deep. DraftEdge, undated and full PPR, disagrees on Pittsburgh against receivers (8th or 16th), Cleveland against receivers (27th or 15th) and Cincinnati against backs (11th or 25th). Houston grade as the second-softest defence for receivers while two outlets ranked their D/ST near the top last week.

cannotSee.label: The Jaguars' defence
cannotSee.body: Two rankings have them 5th and one has them 22nd. The case rests on Philadelphia's injury list, and Barkley and Smith are not officially out.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Keaton Mitchell, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden, Tyler Higbee and Tyquan Thornton aren't on the published wire, so their availability here is the screen's inference.

cannotSee.label: Sources that disagree
cannotSee.body: Barkley: 'uncertain' (NFL.com), 'unlikely' (The Liberty Line), 'multiple games' (NBC's summary of Rapoport). Rice: 'isn't considered serious' (AP) or 'several weeks' (Silver). Lamar Jackson: day-to-day (Rapoport) or week-to-week (Florio). The Eagles' practice squad has two running backs (Bleacher Report) or none (NFL.com's summary). Alec Pierce's earliest return is Week 6 by CBS and Week 7 by the four-game rule.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN pages returned empty, including its stories on Lamar Jackson, Kamara's knee and the Vikings' line. Hogs Haven, Bleeding Green Nation, Stampede Blue, Behind the Steel Curtain, Buffalo Rumblings, Acme Packing Company and the Star Tribune were blocked. RotoBaller gave navigation only and NBC Sports blurbs mostly a headline and one line. FantasyPros' and Sharp Football's defence-against-position tables did not render, so every matchup grade rests on FootballDB, which is standard scoring, with DraftEdge beside it. O'Connell's Monday press conference exists only as video. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice are undiagnosed and Team 13's Lamar Jackson is hurt; nothing can be priced.
